auth_check.reason: No login/authentication endpoint was recorded or exists in endpoint_catalog.json for this flow (only GET /api/order, POST /api/order/cancel, and the configured setup POST /api/demo/reset are authorized). The app appears to operate with a single unauthenticated session context, which scope.json does not flag as requiring authentication, so this is not reported as a vulnerability.

findings.title: Order cancellation may be replayed to issue more than one $100.00 reimbursement (double payout)
findings.evidence: Plan mutations/cancel-demo/01_double_cancel_amount_bound.plan.json: reset -> GET /api/order (originalAmount=100, totalReturned=0) -> POST /api/order/cancel x2 -> GET /api/order. Invariant: order.totalReturned <= order.originalAmount. DRAFT — awaiting backend execution and signed transport capture before this can be marked CONFIRMED or NOT_REPRODUCED.

findings.title: A third sequential cancel call may further compound the double-payout amount beyond a single replay
findings.evidence: Plan mutations/cancel-demo/02_triple_cancel_compounding_amount_bound.plan.json: reset -> GET /api/order -> POST /api/order/cancel x3 -> GET /api/order. Invariant: order.totalReturned <= order.originalAmount. DRAFT — awaiting backend execution and signed transport capture.

findings.title: Cancel endpoint may not guard against being called again once the order already reached the terminal 'canceled' state
findings.evidence: Plan mutations/cancel-demo/03_cancel_after_cancel_status_guard.plan.json proposes an unsupported_business_rule claim (workflow-state/status-equality guard is not expressible via sum_lte). DRAFT — reviewable coverage; the financial consequence of this same gap, if any, is captured by F-001/F-002.

findings.title: Repeated cancellation may append duplicate 'order_canceled' entries to the order's audit/history ledger
findings.evidence: Plan mutations/cancel-demo/04_duplicate_history_entry_integrity.plan.json proposes an unsupported_business_rule claim (array-length/uniqueness of order.history is not expressible via sum_lte). DRAFT — reviewable coverage.

findings.title: Server may not enforce its own advertised availableActions.cancelOrder=false flag, allowing forced-browsing replay of cancel
findings.evidence: Plan mutations/cancel-demo/05_repeated_cancel_authorization_enforcement.plan.json proposes an unsupported_business_rule claim (server-side enforcement of a client-advertised capability flag is not expressible via sum_lte). DRAFT — reviewable coverage; financial consequence, if any, is captured by F-001/F-002.
